L109: # DAS Vitamin Cocktail
L110: 
L111: #### Directions
L112: #### For 100 mL Total
L113:   1. To approximately 85 mL of dH_{2}O add Tricine while stirring continuously.
L114:   2. Adjust the pH to 8.0.
L115:   3. Add each of the remaining components in the order listed.
L116:   4. Bring total volume to 100 mL with dH_{2}O.
L117:   5. Sterilize the vitamin cocktail by filtration through a 0.45 µm Millipore filter.
L118:   6. Store in the dark at freezer temperature.
L119: #  | Component  | Amount  | Stock Solution Concentration  | Final Concentration in DAS
L120: --- | --- | --- | --- | ---
L121: 1  | Tricine
L122: (adjust to pH 8)
L123: (Sigma T 5816-256)  | 0.9 g/100 mL  |  |
L124: 2  | Thiamine
L125: (Sigma T 1270)  | 0.067 g/100 mL  | 2.0 mM  | 0.99 µM
L126: 3  | Biotin
L127: (Sigma B 4639)  | 0.001 g/100 mL  | 0.041 mM  | 0.02 µM
L128: 4  | Vitamin B_{12}
L129: (add after autoclaving)
L130: (Sigma V 6629)  | 0.0008 g/100 mL  | 0.0059 mM  | 0.0029 µM
L131: 5  | Pantothenate
L132: (Sigma P 2250)  | 0.002 g/100 mL  | 0.091 mM  | 0.046 µM
L133: 6  | PABA
L134: (p-aminobenzoic acid)
L135: (Sigma A 1174)  | 0.004 g/100 mL  | 0.291 mM  | 0.15 µM
